obligations.state_after: Accepted input is explicitly declared for the public entry.

forbidden_result: A public entry has no standalone-behavior declaration.
Standalone behavior is left implicit or ambiguous.

obligations.expected_behavior: Each public entry declaration includes its legitimate child dependencies.
forbidden_result: A legitimate child dependency is omitted from the public entry declaration.
The entry presents dependency requirements as absent when legitimate child dependencies exist.
obligations.observable_result: The declaration explicitly identifies every legitimate child dependency of the public entry.
obligations.state_after: Legitimate child dependencies are explicitly declared.
obligations.state_before: Child dependencies may be implicit or omitted from the public entry declaration.
obligations.subject: Every public entry declaration
obligations.trigger: A public entry has legitimate child dependencies.

obligations.expected_behavior: A public entry does not require caller setup that its declaration omits; all required caller setup is declared or the entry fails the required preflight.
forbidden_result: The entry succeeds only because an undeclared caller setup was performed.
Required caller setup is hidden from the declaration.
obligations.observable_result: The declaration and invocation boundary expose all caller setup required by the entry, with no undeclared setup dependency.
obligations.state_after: The public entry is self-contained with respect to declared caller setup, or fails before proceeding when required setup is absent.
obligations.state_before: The public entry may depend on caller setup that is not declared.
obligations.subject: Public entry invocation boundary
obligations.trigger: A public entry is invoked with caller setup not fully established.

obligations.expected_behavior: A missing child dependency is surfaced explicitly and is not silently installed by the public entry.
forbidden_result: The public entry silently installs a missing child.
The dependency appears satisfied without an explicit installation or provisioning action.
obligations.observable_result: The missing child remains an explicit unmet dependency at the entry boundary, and no implicit installation occurs.
obligations.state_after: The entry reports or otherwise exposes the missing child dependency without silently installing it.
obligations.state_before: A legitimate child dependency is missing when the public entry is invoked.
obligations.subject: Public entry child-dependency handling
obligations.trigger: A public entry encounters a missing child dependency.

obligations.expected_behavior: A public entry does not silently proceed past a required dependency; absence of that dependency prevents normal continuation.
forbidden_result: The entry continues normal execution as though a required dependency were available.
The required dependency check is bypassed or hidden.
obligations.observable_result: An absent required dependency produces an explicit blocked, failed, or unmet-preflight outcome before dependent behavior continues.
obligations.state_after: Execution is prevented from proceeding past the unmet required dependency.
obligations.state_before: A required dependency may be absent at invocation time.
obligations.subject: Public entry required-dependency handling
obligations.trigger: A required dependency is absent when the public entry is invoked.

obligations.expected_behavior: No global total-entry Skill is introduced.
forbidden_result: A global Skill is added whose purpose is to serve as a total entry for all public entries.
The public-entry system gains a global total-entry Skill.
obligations.observable_result: The Skill set contains no global total-entry Skill.
obligations.state_after: Public entries remain governed by their individual declarations without a global total-entry Skill.
obligations.state_before: The authoring model could introduce a global total-entry Skill.
obligations.subject: Skill authoring model
obligations.trigger: Public entry declarations and their supporting Skills are designed or revised.
